svg.title: Hubbard: Hamiltonians published at one size
svg.text: Hubbard: Hamiltonians published at one size
Every Hamiltonian of this model with energies published at only one size, grouped where they share lattice, boundary and size;
the coupling or filling that differs between them runs along x. Colour is the kind of number; filled marks can hold a record,
Energies per site as the table quotes them (the impurity problems in total energy), on each panel's own linear scale. Flagged rows, rows without
a declared kind and exact diagonalizations of a single symmetry sector are not drawn.
